title: 1553: Fix scss changed does not recompile src code
body:
Fixes #1153 

So my solution is:
- Clone `node-sass-chokidar` from https://github.com/michaelwayman/node-sass-chokidar/tree/release
- Edit `package.json`, increase version of `node-sass` to latest
- Using pkg to package this project to executable file then we can use as the way we want.

Tested on MacOs

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/26705621/168073061-3c8fd844-8cfd-459e-9bc7-569d57679b74.mov
